ORCH did not kill those processes (they belong to another active session, not ours, and killing another session's live work without clear evidence it is dead is out of scope for this run). Pull this branch fresh and re-run the full suite once more (same command, default N) to confirm: (a) A9 now passes, (b) no new failure was introduced, (c) the same 13 failures from redispatch-3 (12 DBConnection.ConnectionError host-contention failures plus 1 HelpTest tie-break flake) either no longer occur (if the earlier contention was transient) or still structurally clear as unrelated to this branch (empty git diff on the implicated files) -- do not just assume they clear again, re-verify.
